webpResidualInterpretation: Every WebP alpha and every RGB pixel with alpha>0 matches the native PNG. WebP encoding drops otherwise invisible RGB where alpha=0; fullRGBAexact is therefore false. No art/publishedPNG pixels were repaired. This previewcodec residual is not a visible artifact.
